lines.say: Does protein before bed build muscle while you sleep?
While you sleep, you go hours without food. Some people worry the muscle building stops.
In one study, lifters drank forty grams of casein, a slow milk protein, before bed.
It was digested and used through the night. Overnight protein balance improved.
In a twelve week study, the bedtime protein group gained more. But they also ate more protein in total.
When another study kept total protein the same, morning or night made little difference.
So hit your daily protein first. A bedtime snack is an easy way to get there. Milk, yogurt or cottage cheese work.
